pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.2: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū saṃghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā eko heṭṭhā viharati eko upari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.3: uparimo bhikkhu āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ sahasā abhinisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.4: mañcapādo nippaṭitvā heṭṭhimassa bhikkhuno matthake avatthāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.6: bhikkhū upadhāvitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.8: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.10: kathañ hi nāma bhikkhu saṃghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ sahasā abhinisīdissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.12: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu saṃghike . . . abhinisīdasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.15: kathañ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṃghike . . . abhinisīdissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.16: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.17: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:1.18.1: yo pana bhikkhu saṃghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:2.2.1: saṃghike saṃghikasaññī uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdati vā abhinipajjati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:2.2.3: saṃghike puggalikasaññī . . . abhinipajjati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:2.2.6: puggalike puggalikasaññī, aññassa puggalike āpatti dukkaṭassa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc18:2.3.7: tasmiṃ ṭhito gaṇhati vā laggeti vā,
